content:
Maya: Quick question — designing the /v1/jobs POST contract for async tasks. Two asks: what do we return immediately (status code + body) and how do clients poll/cancel? Proposing 202 + body { request_id } + Location: /v1/jobs/{id}. Also require Idempotency-Key header to dedupe. Thoughts?
Omar: 202 + Location + request_id in body is my vote. Most SDKs expect 2xx for accepted. Avoid returning a 200 with state="pending" because it mixes sync/async semantics.
Devon: agree. Important: request_id must be stable for same Idempotency-Key and identical payload. TTL for idempotency records? suggest 24h default.
Maya: 24h default sounds fine. We also need to clarify GET /v1/jobs/:id response shape — minimal fields to support frontends: id, status, result?error, updated_at
Rachel: propose canonical schema:
```json
{
  "id": "str",
  "status": "queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled",
  "result": {...} | null,
  "error": {"code":"...","message":"..."} | null,
  "created_at":"iso8601",
  "updated_at":"iso8601"
}
```
Include a numeric code? No, string statuses ok.
Omar: For polling, return 200 for GET even if queued. Clients should backoff exponential + jitter. Add Retry-After header only for rate-limit or long-poll endpoints.
Maya: Cancel API: DELETE /v1/jobs/:id vs POST /v1/jobs/:id/cancel. What semantics? I prefer POST /.../cancel returning 202 (cancel accepted) and job transitions to cancelling -> cancelled when done. DELETE is often interpreted as idempotent delete of resource; could be confusing.
Devon: Agree use POST /cancel. Return 202 and include same job resource in body with status="cancelling".
Rachel: Edge case: cancelling a succeeded job should 409? I think 409 Conflict if already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled). 404 if id unknown.
Maya: Good point. Also need to document idempotency for cancel calls: repeat cancel should return 202 until final state then 409 if terminal.
qa-automation: test matrix notes — will validate: 1) retry POST with same Idempotency-Key results in same id; 2) GET schema fields present even when result null; 3) cancel transitions; 4) headers Location + Retry-After semantics.
infra-bot: FYI deploy window for these API changes is next wednesday 03:00 UTC. Will need a migration plan for older SDKs that expect synchronous 200.
Maya: Plan for SDKs — ship change log, bump minor version, add helper wait_for(job_id) util. Also we should add backward-compat note: if client does not send Idempotency-Key we'll generate one but no retry guarantees.
Omar: One more: should we include a check for synchronous short tasks (<200ms) that we can respond 200 with result to avoid extra hop? That complicates client logic; I'd avoid. Keep contract pure async.
Maya: ok consensus: always 202 on POST when task scheduled. I'll draft the API spec with the schema Rachel proposed and add idempotency and cancel sections. PR incoming shortly :thumbsup:
